name: Ashikaga Choushin
source: The head of the Ashikaga house, who resembles a fish despite being human. He was supposed to be the successor to the name Ashikaga Takauji, but he calls himself Choushin ("Super God") instead because he thinks of himself as beautiful and powerful. He clearly has a strange sense of beauty.
